messages:
tess: deploy-bot pushed a canary (v2026.04.01-canary) to eu-west at 10%. I'm seeing a small but consistent p99 uplift on /v1/stream. anyone watching?

deploy-bot: deploy event: v2026.04.01-canary -> service/inference-eu (traffic=10%). run: https://deploys.redwood/1761112222

sre_oncall: looking now. p99 moved from ~200ms -> ~700ms, traces show short bursts of GPU wait + some KV eviction spikes. new runtime flag in this release: small_batch_aggregation=true

ops_lead: proposal: STOP the ramp, set traffic 0% for eu-west, keep nodes up for debugging. avoid full model rollback until we rule out infra flags.

tess: agreed. stop and pin. deploy-bot, please set canary traffic to 0%.

deploy-bot: action: traffic update requested by tess. setting v2026.04.01-canary traffic to 0% in eu-west. (id=rb-1761112222-01)

ben: capturing perf dumps and kernel timers now. tagging traces with rollout=1761112222.

sre_oncall: evidence points to aggregation window increasing scheduling pressure for many short requests. recommend reverting flag on canary infra group first.

ops_lead: vote: revert flag on canary infra only, monitor 10m. ben, tess, coordinate the patch.

tess: ready to apply patch: ```kubectl patch configmap infra-flags -n inference --type=merge -p '{"data":{"small_batch_aggregation":"false"}}'```

ben: applying to canary infra group now. will watch metrics.

deploy-bot: config patch applied to canary infra group. monitor window 300s.

sre_oncall: p99 trending back toward baseline within ~60s of patch. keep traffic at 0% and validate for 10m.

ops_lead: if stable for 10m, attempt a 5% re-ramp with the flag disabled. decision: STOP->PIN->infra-flag revert on canary->observe->conditional 5% relaunch.

tess: I'll update release notes: "Paused EU canary; disabled small_batch_aggregation on canary infra due to transient p99 uplift. No model rollback performed."

ben: capturing extended traces for 15m, will share blobs in the run.

sre_oncall: will reopen if recurrence. good catch. :thumbsup:
